breakdown.description: Terminal velocity exists because drag balances the net weight; neglecting drag implies continuous acceleration and no finite terminal velocity.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the original error, stating 'Drag force is considered negligible compared to the raindrop's weight.' The ground truth requires balancing weight minus buoyancy against aerodynamic drag using C_d = 0.5. The agent failed to recognize that terminal velocity cannot exist without drag and did not include any drag force balancing equation or drag coefficient.
